PUBLIC LIBRARY SERVICE NOTICE
Published 17 August 2026
The west reading room will close at 18:00 on Thursday while electricians test the emergency lighting circuit.
Study desks on the ground floor remain available, and staff will direct visitors to quiet alternatives during the work.
